summary: The diff implements WeakSet.prototype.add in its own file, in spec order: RequireInternalSlot via this_weak_set (?), the CanBeHeldWeakly TypeError, a duplicate check that returns this without inserting, an append, and a return of the set. Each step is kept as a comment. No test-shaped branches, no swallowed errors, no made-up values. The only non-spec path is the not-implemented error, and it is not used here. The helpers it calls (this_weak_set, can_be_held_weakly, collection_key, weak_set_table) live in crate::support::collections, which is outside this diff, so I could not inspect them. The gate's remaining failures (WeakSet.prototype.has, Symbol.for) come from the test harness, not from this code.
notes_for_next_attempt: Helpers in crate::support::collections were not part of the diff, so they were not reviewed. Before merging, confirm that this_weak_set performs RequireInternalSlot (TypeError for non-objects and for objects without [[WeakSetData]]), that can_be_held_weakly returns false for symbols registered via Symbol.for (KeyForSymbol not undefined) and true for other symbols, and that collection_key gives SameValue-compatible identity for objects and symbols. The remaining add/ test failures depend on WeakSet.prototype.has and Symbol.for being implemented; they are not defects in this file.
